messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-492233 - prod.runtime.p99 > 700ms (fingerprint: runtime-p99-flap). service=inference-runtime region=us-east-1

Alice: acked and looking. seeing p99 jump on the dashboard. starting root cause triage.

Ben: any 500s or client errors? what do the edge logs show?

Alice: minimal 5xx. mostly streaming stalls and long tail only from two racks. ~0.4% of requests affected. grabbing node metrics now.

carol-sre: checking autoscaler and admission controller. could be background rebalancing or cloud NIC flaps.

Alice: node-level: i-0f1e2d3c and i-0a9b8c7d show elevated retried TCP segments and RX errors. KV cache hit steady. attaching quick snippet:

```
2026-03-15T09:44:01Z runtime: req=ghi789 p99=923ms node=i-0f1e2d3c client=svc-zz
2026-03-15T09:44:02Z runtime: req=jkl012 p99=890ms node=i-0a9b8c7d client=svc-yy
```

dan-dev: cloud provider notes a "scheduled network maintenance" in the affected AZ from 09:40-09:50. That smells like it.

Alice: To reduce customer impact I'll (1) mark those nodes unschedulable, (2) enable temporary reroute to standby pool, (3) kick a small scale-up. Doing steps now.

infra-bot: Action: nodes marked unschedulable: i-0f1e2d3c, i-0a9b8c7d by Alice.

infra-bot: Action: traffic reroute applied for inference-runtime -> standby-pool-us-east-1.

Ben: scaling +3 instances in us-east-1 as buffer: infra-tool scale --service inference-runtime --add 3 (requested).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty PD-492233 auto-resolved after 1m45s (metric under threshold).

Alice: metrics look better but PD re-fired immediately after auto-resolve: PD-492234 (same fingerprint). re-acking.

carol-sre: looks like the cloud maintenance is in two waves across racks; noise will continue until completion. we should silence repeated pages while we monitor. propose 20m mute and an incident ticket.

Ben: agree to mute but add a short suppression rule only for alerts with tag cloud-maintenance=true. also add a cooldown: require 3 datapoints above threshold over 5m.

Alice: muting PD alerts for runtime-p99-flap for 20m. Created ticket INF-8809: "Investigate p99 flapping during provider maintenance; add infra signal to reduce noise." Linked PDs PD-492233/PD-492234. Assigned to infra-team.

incident-bot: Note: PD incidents PD-492233 and PD-492234 closed. Actions: nodes unschedulable, reroute to standby, scale +3, alert muted, INF-8809 created.

dan-dev: heads-up: some customers using streaming connections might have resumed with partial data; customer-success should be notified for any reports.

Alice: paging customer-success now with brief note and expected impact (~0.4% of streaming requests; no data loss).

carol-sre: for post-incident follow-up: (1) add rack-level NIC error dashboard, (2) tie provider-maintenance tag into alert filtering, (3) adjust runtime-p99 alert to be 5m sustained by default.

Ben: +1. I9ll draft RFC for the sustained threshold change and the mute rule.

Alice: handing off to Ben for 10:00 follow-up. summary for handoff: transient p99 spikes during provider maintenance -> partial streaming stalls (~0.4% requests) -> mitigations: unschedulable nodes, reroute to standby, scale +3, 20m mute -> INF-8809 created and CS notified. monitoring continues.

Ben: taking over. will monitor for another 30m and update INF-8809 with timeline. if alerts resume after maintenance we escalate to vendor support.

incident-bot: Thread closed by Alice. Summary appended to INF-8809.
